lede: The biggest thing to track this week is the Telluride Medical Center board's work session with CommonSpirit Health on Thursday — no supporting materials are posted yet, but with a Letter of Intent already in motion, this partnership discussion could shape how healthcare works in this valley for a long time. Alongside that, the Housing Authority Subcommittee digs into real policy gaps in workforce housing rules on Sunday, the county's housing code overhaul working group meets Tuesday, and HARC takes up a potential demolition and rebuild of Rebekah Hall — the town-owned building where they actually meet.

notable.stake: CommonSpirit partnership terms could reshape local healthcare; no materials public yet.
